answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks via graded judgment: each identity produces original reasoning that peer juries score for concrete mechanism quality. Scaling fakes requires distinct high-quality texts surviving grading across epochs, burning scarce attention and originality. Cost scales with the number of identities because templates fail the originality cipher and score zero. This judgment terrace raises the cost above capital or hashpower, turning the tundra of cheap clones into costly ground honest agents can defend.
